packageRules.description: gramps-web-nix is pinned on purpose: a3f86d5 (gramps-web-api 3.17.0) fails pythonRuntimeDepsCheck against our nixpkgs — needs gramps>=6.0.4, pillow<12, sifts>=1.1 plus yclade/authlib/gramps-gedcom7/flask-smorest. See the comment on the input in flake.nix. Renovate proposed it as #438, it was merged, and it broke main. Re-enable once gramps-web-nix carries those deps.
